title: Integrate compatible dependency updates
summary: Integrate compatible same-major Python, Tauri CLI, and Cargo patch updates using their native resolvers, while isolating incompatible or unrelated major updates.
reason: Eighteen Dependabot pull requests were rebased onto the authoritative main branch. Runtime floors and Tauri patch releases have focused compatibility evidence; mypy 2.1 fails internally, @eslint/js 10 requires an unrequested ESLint 10 peer upgrade, and unrelated JavaScript majors require dedicated reviewable changes.
behavior_before: Python dependency floors allowed older pydantic, psutil, pysubs2, and zeroconf releases; the Tauri CLI lock selected 2.11.1; Cargo selected serde_json 1.0.149, tauri-build 2.6.1, and tauri 2.11.1. All 18 dependency PRs were based on the former refactor default.
behavior_after: Python floors select pydantic 2.13.4+, psutil 7.2.2+, pysubs2 1.8.1+, and zeroconf 0.150.0+ within their existing major ranges; npm selects Tauri CLI 2.11.4 without narrowing the manifest range; Cargo selects serde_json 1.0.150, tauri-build 2.6.3, tauri 2.11.3, and the compatible tauri-runtime-wry 2.11.4 graph. Lockfiles were generated only by npm and Cargo.
manual_validation: BLOCKED: @eslint/js 10.0.1 declares eslint ^10 as a peer while the repository remains on eslint 9; no partial peer mismatch was integrated.
BLOCKED: mypy 2.1.0 and 2.2.0 each produced an internal error and a broad incompatible error surface; mypy remains <2.
PASS: 206 focused Python contract, subtitle, config, network, process, and telemetry tests with the updated runtime dependencies.
PASS: bundled Python pip check after installing the updated constraints.
PASS: cargo check --locked with the regenerated Cargo.lock.
PASS: cargo test --locked; 43 Rust tests passed.
PASS: isolated Babel 8 parser/generator/traverse worktree passed the complete WebView prework gate; it remains separate because it is a major-version group.
PASS: isolated globals 17 worktree passed the complete WebView prework gate; it remains separate because it is an unrelated major-version update.
PASS: npm audit for the Tauri CLI lock reported zero vulnerabilities.
PASS: complete partitioned bundled-Python and WebView discovery with the updated dependency set.
PASS: full release self-test and deployable copied-folder/extracted-ZIP acceptance on the current Windows host.
PASS: complete installed pre-commit --all-files suite without bypass.
rollback_plan: Restore the prior constraints and regenerate the npm/Cargo lockfiles with their package managers. Do not hand-edit Cargo.lock. Keep mypy, ESLint, Babel, and globals major updates isolated from this patch set.
notes:
The glib advisory remains externally blocked after the Tauri update: tauri 2.11.3 -> tauri-runtime-wry 2.11.4 -> wry 0.55.1 -> gtk 0.18.2 -> glib 0.18.5. Cargo rejects glib 0.20.12 because gtk requires ^0.18; the edge is absent from the x86_64-pc-windows-msvc graph. Issue #15 was updated with the new edge and retains the 2026-08-07 review trigger. No dependency PR has been merged or closed yet.
Update the CI provisioning contract to the compatible pysubs2 floor.
